cases.description: A warm jacket for a cold trek, with a budget written as "8k" and a size.

turns.user: I'm going trekking in Ladakh in December, need a jacket under 8k, size L.
turns.reply:
Ladakh in December is extremely cold, so warmth extreme/high is inferred. Size L and budget are stated.
For Ladakh in December, go for an extreme-warmth down jacket. The waterproof TrekNorth Summit and Monsoonwear Ridge are the best all-rounders, and the AltiGear Glacier is the lightest to carry. The fleeces work best as a mid-layer under a down jacket.

cases.description: Shoe type, a waterproof attribute and a UK size.

turns.user: Waterproof trekking shoes in UK 9
turns.reply: UrbanStep Glide and TrailKing Terra are the best value picks, both highly rated for less money, and PaceOne Breeze has the highest rating. These come in men's, women's and unisex fits, so check the gender on each card.

cases.description: A boolean attribute with a "15k" budget.

turns.user: A 5G phone under 15k with a good battery
turns.reply: I've put the phones with the biggest batteries first. The Pixelon Nova has a big battery and the best rating of these. The Aurora Zen and Novaphone Nova have even larger batteries but lower ratings.

cases.description: A boolean attribute with a numeric minimum.

turns.user: A waterproof trekking backpack, at least 40 litres
turns.reply: The Commuto Ascent 54 L and TrailCarry Explorer 42 L are the highest-rated and cost less than most of the others. Go for a 57 to 70 L pack if you're doing multi-day treks, and a 42 to 49 L one if you're doing weekend trips.

cases.description: Three attributes, one of which (gender) also accepts unisex.

turns.user: An analog watch with a leather strap for men
turns.reply: The Kaal Luxe is a good middle pick, with strong ratings at a moderate price. The Kaal Pulse has the best reviews but costs the most, and the Horizon Active is the cheapest but has a lower rating.

cases.description: An appliance type with a budget.

turns.user: Air fryer under ₹6,000
turns.reply: The Annapurna Eco is the top-rated pick and comes with a 3-year warranty. If you're cooking for a family, the Swaad Turbo has the biggest basket here and the longest warranty at 5 years.

cases.description: Adding an attribute keeps the earlier budget and size.

Ladakh in December is extremely cold, so I'll infer warmth high/extreme as a soft constraint... Actually inferred attribute filters are fine but droppable.

cases.description: Narrowing to one brand keeps the type and budget.

turns.user: Trekking shoes under ₹6,000
turns.reply: The PaceOne Terra has the best ratings and comes in every size, but it isn't waterproof. If you'll trek in the rain, the UrbanStep Glide (men's) or TrailKing Metro (women's) are waterproof.

turns.user: only from TrailKing
turns.reply: The SHO-00221 TrailKing Metro is waterproof, highly rated and comes in the most sizes. The TrailKing Apex is the cheapest top-rated pick, but it isn't waterproof.

cases.description: "The second one" resolves against the shown list. The second-cheapest backpack is an UrbanSling.

turns.user: Show me the 3 cheapest backpacks
turns.reply: The Commuto Ridge has the best rating of the three and lots of space. The UrbanSling Ridge is the only one that's waterproof and has a laptop compartment.

turns.user: Tell me more about the second one
turns.reply: The UrbanSling Ridge 34 L Travel Backpack costs ₹439 (MRP ₹505) and is rated 3.8 from 1,719 reviews. It's a waterproof travel bag with a laptop compartment, several pockets and padded shoulder straps, and it comes in maroon or black.

cases.description: Comparing the first two shown. The two cheapest phones are a Zentrix and an Aurora.

turns.user: Show me the 3 cheapest phones
turns.reply: The Aurora Neo costs a little more than the Zentrix, but it has double the storage, a bigger battery and the highest rating of the three. None of these support 5G.

turns.user: Compare the first two
turns.reply: The Aurora Neo (₹7,229) beats the Zentrix Neo (₹7,099) on everything that differs: 128 GB vs 64 GB storage, 5237 vs 4223 mAh battery, 64 vs 12 MP camera and a 6.3 vs 6.1 inch screen. It's also rated higher, so it's the better pick unless you need the lowest price.

I couldn't find any extreme-warmth jackets under ₹2,000, so I dropped the warmth filter. The best here are only moderate warmth, so none of them will keep you warm at -20 degrees by itself. The fleece works best as a layer under a down jacket.

cases.description: Comparing the two top-rated smartwatches, a Kaal and a Vela; the follow-up asks for the brand.

turns.user: Top 3 rated smartwatches
turns.reply: The Kaal Pulse is a men's watch, and the Vela Orbit and Chronex Orbit are women's watches. The Vela Orbit is the cheapest of the three and has the best water resistance, matched only by the Chronex Orbit.

turns.user: Which brands are the top two, and how do they compare?
turns.reply: The top two are Kaal (Kaal Pulse Smartwatch, men's) and Vela (Vela Orbit Smartwatch, women's), and both are rated 5.0. The Kaal costs ₹25,829 and has a fabric strap with 30m water resistance, while the Vela costs ₹2,209 and has a metal strap with 100m water resistance.

cases.description: Choosing between the two cheapest mixer grinders, a Kitchenmate and a Tava; the follow-up asks for the brand.

turns.user: 3 cheapest mixer grinders
turns.reply: The Kitchenmate Eco costs a little more than the other two, but it has the best rating of the three, a bigger jar and a 5-year warranty. The Tava Prime has the least power.

turns.user: Which brands are the first two, and which suits daily chutney and masala better?
turns.reply: The first is from Kitchenmate (Kitchenmate Prime Mixer Grinder) and the second is from Tava (Tava Prime Mixer Grinder). For daily chutney and masala, the Kitchenmate Prime is the better pick: it has more power (947W vs 681W) and a slightly higher rating, while both have 0.8L capacity and a 3-year warranty.
